Neither single-deletion cohort met its 3/3 prediction. Earlier cf5a339b0cd90, retaining both own tokens, recorded 3/3 clean completions; c91be84043ecf, deleting both, recorded 0/3. There are no pending trace audits and no newly measured 3/3 cohort. Comparisons to prior parents remain temporally unmatched; length and semantics change together in parent deletions. Selected cohorts are not pooled and no robustness or wholly-unaided claim is made. The prior cf5a339b0cd90 audit also retains its disclosed source-output truncation limitation and engine-discovery probe observation.
